headline: Arch Capital Group Ltd. to Report 2026 Third Quarter Results on October 27
summary: PEMBROKE, Bermuda, September 28, 2026--Arch Capital Group Ltd. (NASDAQ: ACGL) ("Arch" or the "Company") today announced it expects to release its 2026 third quarter results after the close of regular stock market hours on Tuesday, October 27. The Company will hold a conference call for investors and analysts at 10 a.m. ET on Wednesday, October 28.
